heroHeadline: Day 4,742: 'SWIM' Ties 'Dynamite' Record; FESTA Day 7 'Normal Log' + Song Re-Releases; 13th Anniversary Concerts 5 Days Away
heroSubtitle: June 7, 2026 is Day 4,742 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. BTS FESTA 2026 Day 7 resumes following the Korean Memorial Day pause (June 6): Big Hit Music releases the 'Normal Log' behind-the-scenes vlog on Weverse, accompanied by three anniversary-themed song re-releases across streaming platforms — 'Never Let Go' (Jungkook, 2024), 'Bicycle' (RM, 2021), and 'Dear. ARMY' live clip (Jimin, 2023) — each selected for their emotional resonance with the BTS–ARMY relationship during the final week before the 13th anniversary. On the chart dated June 6, 'SWIM' achieves its 8th consecutive week at No. 1 on the Billboard Global (Excl. US) chart, officially tying 'Dynamite' (2020) for BTS's longest-ever run at the top of that chart; 'SWIM' simultaneously rises to No. 4 on the Billboard Global 200. BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Busan entered Day 3 of operation with fan installations active across the city. The Busan Asiad Main Stadium anniversary concerts (June 12–13) are now 5 days away; June 13 marks the exact 13th debut anniversary and will be live-streamed globally via Trafalgar Releasing cinema viewing. On June 12, the previously vinyl-exclusive track 'Come Over' (produced by Suga with RM and J-Hope) will receive its digital release alongside a Lyric Video and the ARIRANG 613 Picture Disc Vinyl drop.
